subject: Accelerated MAP: security handoff, evidence and retention windows
messages:
From: Ellen Price <ellen.price@maplebank.com>
To: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 7 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP timeline & security checkpoints — can we compress this?

Hi Ava / Marissa —

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. We liked the performance numbers, but procurement wants a tighter MAP with clear handoff dates for security items before we sign the DPA. Specifically they asked for: SOC 2 evidence window, SIG/CAIQ completion, DPA redline turnaround, and explicit data-retention commitments (archival vs active delete).

Can your team provide an accelerated close plan that shows milestones in the next 4 business days? Procurement is willing to accept staged evidence (SOC 2 report + SIG matrix first, DPA redline second) if dates are explicit.

Attachments: initial_security_questions.xlsx (contains procurement's list)

Best,
Ellen
Ellen Price
Head of Infrastructure Risk — Maple Bank
ellen.price@maplebank.com

From: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Price <ellen.price@maplebank.com>, procurement@maplebank.com
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 7 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP timeline & security checkpoints — can we compress this?

Thanks Ellen — appreciate the clarity. Below is an accelerated MAP we can commit to given the ask for staged evidence. Please see inline milestones and owners.

High-level MAP (accelerated, 4 business days):
- Day 0 (today): Acknowledge scope; Redwood to deliver SOC 2 report Q4 2026 (redacted) + current SIG matrix within 24h. Owner: Ava.
- Day 1: Review DPA redlines (we will accept your suggested minimal carveouts). Owner: Kimberly. Draft back by EOD Day 1.
- Day 2: Procurement and Legal review; if no escalations, DocuSign pre-sign packet prepared. Owner: Jonas (contracts).
- Day 3: Evidence handoff for token/log sampling and archival policy walkthrough (call). Owner: Marissa.
- Day 4: Final sign + canary activation (limited production keys / sample dataset).

Security/compliance checkpoints (what we'll deliver):
- SOC 2: Full report (redacted PII) + assertion letter. Scope: production inference; retention policy annex attached.
- SIG/CAIQ: Completed matrix with mapping to our SOC 2 controls and evidence pointers (SIG_Matrix.xlsx).
- DPA: Redline v3 enclosed; we will accept a standard data-residency clause with 90-day archival (option to shorten to 30 days for higher-tier contracts).
- Data retention: Active inference logs retained 30 days by default; escrow/archive lifecycle: 90 days in hot storage, 2 years in cold archive (customer-selectable).
- Evidence transfer: Secure S3 link + audit log extract; we will provide a short verification checklist for your compliance team.

Attachments we are sending now: SOC2_Report_Q4_2026.pdf (redacted), SIG_Matrix.xlsx, DPA_Redline_v3.docx

If procurement agrees to staged acceptance (SOC2 + SIG first), we can be ready to sign on Day 4. If you need the retention window shortened, flag that now — it is negotiable on committed capacity.

Next steps: Ellen — confirm that staged acceptance is ok and whether 30-day active retention is a hard requirement.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Price <ellen.price@maplebank.com>, ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP timeline & security checkpoints — evidence handoff notes

Ellen — quick operational clarifications to keep the MAP tight: 

Operational evidence we will provide on Day 3 call:
- Audit log extract (sample): last 30 days, redacted identifiers.
- KV/prefix caching behavior note and where sensitive prefixes are protected.
- Token sampling methodology (we sample metadata, not payloads; payload-level captures require customer approval).
- Access control matrix + names for SRE folks who will perform the walkthrough.

Two pragmatic asks from our side: 
1) For the canary, provide a small anonymized dataset and access window (we recommend a 24h canary).
2) Confirm whether escrow of keys is required for the pilot — that adds a 48h ops task.

We can slot the evidence call for Day 3 in the morning (09:30 PT) if that works.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Security Operations
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Price <ellen.price@maplebank.com>, procurement@maplebank.com
Cc: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP timeline & security checkpoints — contracts and sign-off

Ellen / Procurement —

Quick note on contracting logistics so we hit Day 4 sign: 
- DPA Redline v3 contains the retention annex and a 90-day default. If you'd like 30-day active retention, mark the DPA with "Retention=30" and we will accept on a signed SOW with committed throughput.
- I have prepared a DocuSign packet for the DPA + SOW (pre-filled) pending your legal's green light. Link: https://docusign.com/embedded/abcdef-Maple-DPA
- SLA note: We can commit to the standard 99.9% inference availability SLA for hosted customers on Dedicated capacity; a separate SLA appendix is required for private deployments.

If procurement signs off on staged evidence and the retention window, we will route DocuSign on Day 2 evening for a Day 4 sign.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships (Contracts), Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

From: Ellen Price <ellen.price@maplebank.com>
To: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP timeline & security checkpoints — can we compress this?

Team —

Maple Procurement confirms staged acceptance. We will: 
- Accept SOC2_Report_Q4_2026.pdf + SIG_Matrix.xlsx as initial evidence by tomorrow EOD.
- Legal will review DPA_Redline_v3.docx; retention preference: 30-day active / 365-day cold archive. We can accept 90-day if necessary, but prefer 30.
- For the canary: agree to a 24h window with anonymized dataset; escrow of keys NOT required for the pilot.

Please route the DocuSign packet once DPA redline is updated to reflect retention=30. Schedule the evidence call for Day 3 at 09:30 PT.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — if everything lands as planned we will have sign-off and initial keys on Day 4.

Thanks,
Ellen
Ellen Price
Head of Infrastructure Risk — Maple Bank
ellen.price@maplebank.com
